newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures go mostly higher, off highs.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures go mostly higher, off highs.

text.p: April 15 - IMM currency futures turned mostly higher but were off day's peaks. Brokers said currencies rose earlier as U.S. stocks cut their biggest gains. Some also comments by Buba's Hesse that Buba has no choice but to insist on strict EMU criteria also buoyed marks. June Swiss cleared resistance near $0.6850 on rise. Late volume was light.
